marks.gloss_en: תניא נמי הכי: מסככין בבודיא, ואם יש להן קיר אין מסככין בהן
Ulla: these mats of the people of Mechoza -- were it not for their wall, one would roof with them
אמר מר: כל החוצלות מטמאין טמא מת, דברי רבי דוסא. והתניא: וכן היה רבי דוסא אומר כדבריו!
לא קשיא: הא דאית ליה גדנפא, הא דלית ליה גדנפא (= p_okimta_im_gedanfa, p_okimta_belo_gedanfa)
the stam: this [R' Dosa's corpse impurity, the mishna] -- of one that has an upturned edge

מיתיבי ... בשלמא למאן דאמר מרזובלי -- sha'am and gemi fit for fruit baskets, sak and sfira for small sacks and baskets; אלא למאן דאמר מחצלות ממש -- sak and sfira are fit for screens and sieves, but sha'am and gemi, for what are they fit?
the baraita: chotzalot of sha'am, of gemi, of sak and of sfira become impure with corpse impurity -- R' Dosa
חזו לנזיאתא (= p_shaam_gemi_nazyata)
[on 'marzovlei'] those of sha'am and gemi are fit for a fruit basket

איכא דאמרי: בשלמא למאן דאמר מחצלות ממש -- sha'am and gemi for ale vats, sak and sfira for screens and sieves; אלא למאן דאמר מרזובלי -- sak and sfira for small sacks and baskets, but sha'am and gemi, for what are they fit?
חזו לכינתא דפירי (= p_shaam_gemi_kinta)
...and those of Tiberias -- that they are pure
R' Chananya: when I went down to the exile I found an elder who told me [a ruling]; and when I came to R' Yehoshua my father's brother, he agreed with his words
והא ליכא עשרה! -- the space under a bed is not ten high, so it is no tent
תרגמא שמואל במטה עשרה (= p_shmuel_mita_asara)
Shmuel interpreted the mishnah as speaking of a bed ten [tefachim] high
one who sleeps under the bed in the sukkah has not fulfilled his obligation
a hole bored by water or creeping things or eaten out by salt, a course of stones, a pile of beams -- forms a tent over impurity
R' Yehuda: any tent not made by man is not a tent
R' Shimon: an incident with Tavi, Rabban Gamliel's slave, who used to sleep under the bed
